title: Intune enrolment device limit is at its maximum

maxLimit.text: Limit at or above which no practical restriction remains

report.title: {Items.Count} device limit {Plural(Items.Count, 'restriction is', 'restrictions are')} effectively unlimited

messages.businessImpact: One account can enrol {params.maxLimit} devices, which is as many as Intune allows, so a compromised account can register machines the organisation has no record of buying.
remediation: Reduce the limit to the number a user realistically needs, commonly two or three. Intune will not accept a value above {params.maxLimit}, so a restriction set there is not a restriction.
messages.cannotSee: This is the Intune enrolment restriction, which caps how many devices one account may enrol into Intune. It is a different limit from the directory's own join quota, which ENR-021 reads, and a tenant can have one set sensibly and the other not. Whether fifteen is wrong for this organisation is a judgement: a shared or lab account may need it.
